requirement.description: RLP encoding functions fail due to missing 'rlp' package dependency for certain operations. The implementation falls back to using the 'rlp' package but doesn't properly handle the case when it's not installed.
requirement.contract: Ensure that when 'rlp' package is not available, the implementation provides proper error messages and alternative fallback mechanisms for RLP decoding operations. The rlp_encode function should handle string data correctly regardless of the presence of the 'rlp' package.

requirement.description: Missing imports for cryptographic dependencies (ecdsa, hashlib) required for signature-related functions. The error messages don't clearly indicate which packages are missing.
requirement.contract: Update the cryptographic functions to properly import required dependencies and provide clear error messages indicating which packages are missing (ecdsa, hashlib).

requirement.description: CREATE2 address computation fails due to missing keccak hash functionality. The implementation needs to properly compute keccak256 hashes for CREATE2 address derivation.
requirement.contract: Implement proper keccak256 hashing for CREATE2 address derivation using either hashlib or the appropriate crypto library. Ensure the get_created_address function works correctly with salt and init_code parameters.

requirement.description: CLI command fails because it's not properly importing or using the RLP encoding functions from the binary module.
requirement.contract: Fix the rlp_encode_command to properly handle input parsing and correctly call the binary.rlp_encode function with appropriate parameters.

requirement.description: Some RLP encoding functions have incorrect handling of edge cases, particularly around string and list encoding.
requirement.contract: Improve the RLP encoding logic to correctly handle all edge cases including empty strings, single character strings, and complex nested data structures.
